$comment: Plans as data. Prices lived in HTML three times and contradicted themselves twice — EUR 9 beside USD 99, then a Subscribe button to a Sponsors page that was never enabled. CI renders this file against support.html so a figure cannot drift without failing the build.

launch_annual.name: Launch Annual
launch_annual.billing: prepaid for twelve months from payment confirmation
launch_annual.$comment: Entitlements are not repeated here. This plan grants `premium_pro`; one definition, so the two cannot diverge and no test is needed to notice that they have.

provisioning.statement: Provisioning is manual and begins after the payment confirms on chain. There is no billing backend; nothing on this site pretends otherwise.

cadence.private_statement: Custom cadence is agreed during provisioning and is bounded by GitHub's rate limits. No figure is promised before that conversation.
